about: Modwerk source-only live-rec-retrig-fix package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/live-rec-retrig-fix.

mods.title: Live Rec Retrig Fix
mods.summary: LIVE RECORDING records every pad retrig hit as a real trig, with the velocity and timing you played. While the sequencer plays, every pad retrig falls on its swung grid (Retrig Grid).
mods.description: LIVE RECORDING records every pad retrig hit as a real trig, with the velocity and timing you played. While the sequencer plays, every pad retrig falls on its swung grid (Retrig Grid).
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: This source ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 in a 16-module combined image (LP01, as reported): recording a roll, Retrig Grid and the RTRG key pass; this package has not run alone on a unit.
